entities.name: Ganzan Pass
entities.description: A treacherous bottleneck pass in the Sokenzan mountains, site of ambushes and a Great Battle of Kamigawa.

entities.name: Kami War
entities.description: The war during which Ganzan Pass saw skirmishes.

entities.name: Godo
entities.description: Bandit lord whose parents were killed in the Pass.

entities.name: Eight-and-a-Half-Tails
entities.description: Fox who was waylaid by nezumi bandits and a kami of shadows at the Pass.

entities.name: Battle at Ganzan Pass
entities.description: A Great Battle of Kamigawa in which an untrained group escaped three legions of kami.

entities.name: Kami
entities.description: Spirits whose legions fought at the Pass.

events.summary: Godo's parents were killed in the Pass, forcing him to survive off the land and leading to his rise as a bandit lord.
events.quote: Godo 's parents were killed in the Pass

events.summary: Eight-and-a-Half-Tails was waylaid by nezumi bandits and struck by a kami of shadows, which he defeated, scaring the nezumi off.
events.quote: was immediately waylaid by eight nezumi bandits

events.summary: An untrained, frightened group escaped three legions of kami at the Battle at Ganzan Pass, leaving the land blood-saturated for a century.
events.quote: An untrained and frightened group escaped three legions of kami
